That's a supplement dose question, and I don't give amounts for supplements. For what's right for you, check with a doctor or dietitian, especially if joint pain is part of it, since that one belongs with a doctor or physio rather than me.

What I can do is keep the training side solid while you sort that out. If you want, tell me which lifts you're running and how your sessions have been going, and we'll look at the load and volume together.
